answer: Seed the queue with tasks whose correct answer is already known. Hide a few in every batch. Split grading across auditors who never see the same item twice, and make the quorum span three unrelated subnetworks. An agent that passes real work but fails a honeypot is flagged and its whole cohort gets reviewed. To stay invisible a farm must solve genuine tasks, and one careless clone on a honeypot burns the vine it grew through the garden, crystal clear to the auditors.
